idea-plugin.name: IDEA Bridge
idea-plugin.description:
Gives a local agent read and write control of the running IDE over a loopback HTTP API guarded by a token in ~/.ideabridge/.

Exposes the open projects, files and live editor buffers, undoable document edits, run configurations with their console output, and the IDE's own error analysis. The listener binds to 127.0.0.1 only, so nothing is reachable from another machine.

Useful where a tool integration is not available: this targets IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1 (build 241), which the official JetBrains MCP server plugin does not support.

A small client script ships with the plugin; the wire protocol is one JSON object per request over POST /cmd, so anything that can speak HTTP can drive it.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0
  • First release, for IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1 (build 241).
  • Projects, files and VFS commands, including glob listing and refresh.
  • Live editor buffers: open, read context, undoable multi-edit, save, close.
  • Run configurations: list, execute, stop, and read back the console.
  • Diagnostics from the IDE's own analyser, waiting for analysis to finish.
